---
title: "14 · Capstone design review"
---

What evidence justifies deploying the added autonomy?

## Concepts

Combine a measured comparison with a review of state, access, reliability, and operating cost. State which hypothesis the evidence supports, the applicable limits, and how to falsify it.

## Study task

Choose the AutoResearch scenario or the [citation assistant](../exercises/index.qmd#research-assistant-with-citations). Compare a fixed workflow and an adaptive controller on an identical test set and budget.

## Deliverable

Submit an architecture diagram, executable baseline, evaluation table, reproducible trace, failure analysis, and a decision record. Include a rerun command, data and code versions, and a proposed follow-up experiment.
